'''Heb Nee''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] warrior who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a member of the [[Rorgungans]],<ref name="SWG:RGST" /> a group of extremist Gungans who violently opposed [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass's]] support of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo's human population]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and rejected any alliance between humans and Gungans.<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Heb Nee served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hassk (Gungan)|Hassk]], the Rorgungan commander, in the [[Gungan Swamp Town]], along with fellow Lieutenant [[Ori (Gungan)|Ori]].<ref name="SWG:RGST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Heb Nee was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:RGST" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Heb Nee was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
